Source drawCard fact + sink dies-want both carry oncePerTurn:true (documentary only, same as elrond-moon-reader's own precedent) for the real 'This ability triggers only once each turn' cap — no per-turn trigger-count enforcement exists anywhere in this engine (see ENGINE_GAPS.md), so a scenario just exercises one firing. scenarios.ts rewritten from a bare {trigger:'onOtherPermanentsDie'} flat scenario (which produced zero cast/enters trace evidence, since harness.ts's own lifecycleBefore/After skip the lifecycle entirely for a trigger-shaped scenario) to a real engine-piloted playthrough (cast -> enters -> a real SEPARATE creature you control, Town Greeter, dies in real lethal blocked combat against a real Coeurl -> onOtherPermanentsDie fires manually -> real drawCard), giving real trace backing for self-cast/self-enters/drawCard/dies-want alike.
